trial.title: Try writing a consultation
trial.subtitle: Write and pick close matches in the same order as the real service. No sign-up or login needed.
trial.safe: Nothing you write is saved. To find close matches, only a version with contact details hidden is passed to AI.
trial.sampleNote: The example is fictional. It includes a name and contact details on purpose, so you can see how they are hidden.

sample.words: My name is Hanako Yamada. I live in Room 203, Corpo Himawari, 6-18-1 Suizenji, Chuo-ku, Kumamoto. My husband lost his job, our household income has dropped and we cannot pay the rent. We have been told to move out next month, and we may lose a safe place to live. My mobile number is 090-1234-5678.
sample.since: For three months, since my husband's company (03-1234-5678) went bankrupt
sample.wish: I want to keep living in our current home. Please contact me at hanako.yamada@example.com or LINE ID: hanako_0123

trial.overlapNote: AI is not available right now, so this only shows items that share Japanese words with what you wrote.
trial.noneIsOk: If nothing fits, you can go on without choosing.
trial.needsWords: Write even a few words to go on
trial.resultLead: In the real service, after you send it, AI writes a short summary for supporters. Before the text is passed to AI, anything that looks like contact details is hidden as shown below.
trial.beforeNote: The colored parts were found as things to hide.
trial.afterNote: The parts found are replaced with a marker.
trial.limitTitle: Some things cannot be hidden automatically
trial.limitBody: Names, schools and workplaces cannot be found automatically. Also, only the text passed to AI is hidden; supporters see what you wrote as it is. In the real service, please do not write your name, phone number or address.
trial.readerTitle: Only our team and members of organizations we have interviewed and approved can read this
trial.readerBody: It is never made public on the internet.
trial.aiNote: The AI we use is under terms that do not use what we send for training.
trial.guardLead: Besides hiding personal information, we use several layers of protection so the AI cannot be misused.
trial.guard1: Even if a consultation contains commands meant to trick the AI, the AI is set up not to follow them.
trial.guard2: If the AI writes a link or an email address, it is not shown on the screen.
trial.guard3: The AI can only write text. It cannot see or change any consultation data.
trial.guard4: You are the one who chooses what you are troubled by. Whether it is urgent is also decided by fixed rules, not by AI.
trial.nextTitle: What happens next in the real service
